title: Arkret Authenticated Signer Resolution Evidence
description: Content-addressed immutable signer-key resolution material retained for historical verification. The evidence ref is derived from the SHA-256 digest of the complete RFC 8785 JCS object; callers never substitute a current resolver result.

signer_evidence_ref.description: ak:signer_evidence:sha256:<hex>, where hex is SHA-256(RFC8785-JCS(complete evidence object)). The embedded hex is the sole wire carrier of the evidence digest; a carrier that holds this ref MUST NOT also carry a sibling *_digest mirror of it (encoding.md 4.0.1).

service_signer_evidence.description: Retain method-native evidence and its normalized DID document together. signer_id equals authenticated_resolution.service_id. Verify the complete native history and verification_method authorization at the retained state. Durable historical evidence permits did:key or complete did:webvh history; did:web cannot prove historical signer authority. Current route cache expiry does not retroactively invalidate retained evidence. Complete canonical evidence is at most 1 MiB.

normalized_did_document.description: Exact normalized DID document whose digest and history position are authenticated by public_resolution.method_history_evidence.

principal_signer_evidence.description: attester_signer_evidence_ref resolves to a service-kind leaf that historically verifies the Station projection attestation. Current route or DID expiry is not a retrospective validity input.

account_device_signer_evidence.description: Ordinary-human history-response device authority only. signer_id equals the attested AccountId principal; verification_method is that principal DID plus the exact device-id fragment. The source ActorId equals the complete attested AccountId and its sender domain equals the device ID. Verify the retained Station attester closure and device projection at source_proof.created_at, within its positive validity interval. Later expiry does not invalidate accepted history; first enqueue still checks current device/generation and membership. This branch does not authorize DID-document, notary or Control Event signatures.

agent_signer_evidence.description: Two current refs authenticate the Agent Authority lease and Account Authority gate. Original Station-admitted genesis and key authorization Events in state authenticate notary delegation and controller device keys. Historical evidence additionally requires receiver_signer_evidence_ref for the original Station admission or distinct receiver receipt; current evidence forbids it. Every canonical root retains complete state.
